en: The image shows a black-and-white historic street scene, featuring large stone or brick buildings with multi-paned windows and decorative rooflines. The street is paved with cobblestones and is relatively empty, with some tram tracks visible. There is a wrought-iron fence in front of one of the buildings. On the right, a building has signage on the wall, and leafless small trees line the street. The overall architecture hints at late 19th to early 20th-century Central European urban design.
